observations: Viewed five sampled stages from both external cameras and wrist camera. The original glass remains upright on its added pedestal in front of the microwave. The arm approaches beside the glass and reaches the original handle. Later images show the handle operation and released hold; the door angle is visually modest with partial rail and arm occlusion. Wrist views corroborate the glass at approach and close appliance panel/handle views later. Native predicate, contact and geometry audits provide the quantitative acceptance evidence.
review_scope: Sampled actual recorded RGB frames, not every frame.
